summary: Verified Turnstile fix on /login: the widget with data-testid='turnstile-widget' now renders on the target preview URL (6683466e) and Cloudflare test key auto-passes. Backend correctly enforces Turnstile: empty token -> 400 'Verificação de segurança falhou', non-empty test token -> passes and reaches auth logic. HOWEVER, the two preview hosts referenced (6683466e-... and eed5ff5f-...) route to DIFFERENT backend pods with DIFFERENT MongoDBs. QA seed (scripts/seed_qa_user.py) ran only on THIS pod (which is served at eed5ff5f-...). On the 6683466e pod there is no qa.teste@gestorcred.com user, so login through the intended URL returns 401 'Credenciais inválidas' (and after 3 attempts triggers the 429 brute-force block).

critical.issue: Returns 401 'Credenciais inválidas' for qa.teste@gestorcred.com / Teste@2026 because that pod's MongoDB does not have the QA seed user. Same request against localhost:8001 and against https://eed5ff5f-...preview.emergentagent.com returns 200 with access_token. Confirmed the two preview URLs are different pods via a temporary marker in GET /api/ (eed5ff5f saw the marker, 6683466e did not).

minor.issue: Repeated failed attempts leave account locked for ~30 minutes (brute-force). During testing this masked further debugging; had to purge login_attempts collection to retry.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend hardcodes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to the 6683466e host (in both frontend/.env and public/env-config.js). That host maps to a different backend pod without the seeded QA user, so the login flow always fails with 'Credenciais inválidas' even though Turnstile passes.

action_items: Decide which pod is the real target for the user's app: (a) If 6683466e-... is correct, run /app/backend/scripts/seed_qa_user.py inside THAT pod (or restore the mongodump backup there) so qa.teste@gestorcred.com / Teste@2026 exists. (b) If this pod (eed5ff5f-...) is correct, change REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in both /app/frontend/.env and /app/frontend/public/env-config.js to 'https://cred-dashboard.preview.emergentagent.com' and reload the frontend.
Clear brute-force lock (db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})) after any repeated failed manual testing on the affected pod.
Consider removing the hardcoded URL from /app/frontend/public/env-config.js so it doesn't override /app/frontend/.env silently.
critical_code_review_comments: public/env-config.js overrides frontend/.env at runtime (window._env_ takes precedence in src/config/env.js). This is a footgun — any change to .env is silently ignored unless env-config.js is also updated.

backend/routes/auth.py returns generic 'Credenciais inválidas' for both 'user not found' and 'wrong password' (good for security) but makes environment mismatches like this one hard to diagnose. Consider a debug log line (already present as print) but flush=True so it appears in supervisor logs.
supervisor config still points APP_URL to the old eed5ff5f host; if any backend code relies on APP_URL (email links, callbacks) it will link users to the wrong pod.

success_rate.backend: 100% on this pod (eed5ff5f), 0% on target pod (6683466e) for QA login
success_rate.frontend: Turnstile widget render + auto-pass verified on 6683466e

test_credentials: qa.teste@gestorcred.com / Teste@2026 (only seeded on THIS pod / eed5ff5f-... host)
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/scripts/seed_qa_user.py against local Mongo (db 'gestorcred'). Also purged db.login_attempts to clear brute-force lock. Neither of these propagated to the 6683466e pod because it is a separate environment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two preview hosts referenced in this project route to DIFFERENT pods. Verify with: curl https://<host>/api/ after adding a temporary marker to routes/__init__.py — only the pod being edited will echo the marker. QA seed only exists on the eed5ff5f pod. Turnstile UI + backend integration is confirmed working end-to-end when the same pod holds both the seeded user and the frontend.
rca of the issue: Root cause: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (both in frontend/.env and hardcoded again in public/env-config.js) points to https://6683466e-...preview.emergentagent.com, but the QA user seeding, mongodump restore, and all backend code edits performed in this workspace target the pod served at https://eed5ff5f-...preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed by injecting a marker field into GET /api/ and observing it only appeared on the eed5ff5f response. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login with valid QA creds to 6683466e -> 401; identical POST to eed5ff5f (or localhost:8001) -> 200 with access_token. Mitigation: either (1) run seed_qa_user.py on the 6683466e pod's DB, or (2) point the frontend at the eed5ff5f backend by editing frontend/.env AND frontend/public/env-config.js (both must be changed because window._env_ overrides process.env).
